terms.title: Terms of service
terms.subtitle: How the namke websites and apps work

operation.title: 1. How namke works
operation.paragraph1: namke is a community digital platform giving access to authentic African cuisine. It lets you order meals prepared by genuine cooks and chefs, straight to your home, workplace, or any other location of your choice.
operation.paragraph2: The namke experience relies on a local delivery service run by independent couriers and selected partners, ensuring your meals reach you in optimal condition.

culinaryPartners.title: Our culinary partners
culinaryPartners.paragraph1: The partners whose offers appear on namke are catering professionals or individuals under contract with namke, specialising in traditional African cuisines.
culinaryPartners.paragraph2: Before joining the platform, every restaurant partner goes through a verification process including identity checks, hygiene certifications and legal operating permits.

deliveryPartners.title: Delivery partners
deliveryPartners.paragraph1: Your meals may be delivered straight to your address by our independent couriers or logistics partners. They are not legally bound to namke and may accept or decline a delivery at their discretion.

withdrawalRight.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawalRight.paragraph1: Food orders are prepared on demand: no right of withdrawal applies once the order is confirmed. If there's an error or issue, contact customer service through the platform.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.paragraph1: namke provides secure payment methods: credit card (Visa, Mastercard), PayPal and Stripe. All payments are processed exclusively by certified providers meeting international banking security standards.

disputes.title: Disputes and customer service
disputes.paragraph1: The sales contract is established directly between you and our culinary partners. namke acts as a trusted third party in this commercial relationship and offers support accessible through the platform.

ratingSystem.title: Rating and trust system
ratingSystem.paragraph1: After each order, you can rate the quality of the service provided by our culinary partners and couriers. Our partners can also rate their customers.

help.title: How can we help you?
help.subtitle: Find answers to the most frequent questions, or contact our team directly.

tracking.q: How do I track my order?
tracking.a: Open the Orders tab from your profile: the status (preparing, out for delivery, delivered) updates there in real time.

refund.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
refund.a: Dishes are prepared on demand as soon as the order is confirmed, which excludes a right of withdrawal. If there's an issue, contact us: we'll route your request to the relevant partner.

paymentMethods.a: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard) as well as PayPal and Stripe. All payments are processed by certified providers.

twoFactor.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
twoFactor.a: In Profile > Settings > Security, turn on the toggle and confirm your password. Be sure to save the key and backup codes shown, as they're only displayed once.
